item.title: Democrats Prepare Musk Probe Over Satellite Cuts
item.description: Senate Democrats have asked Elon Musk to preserve documents concerning the slowdown of Starshield in Ukraine, CNN reported. The move prepares for investigations when Democrats take control of Congress in January 2027. Lawmakers are also seeking to retain records linked to Russian diesel transactions as they prepare closer scrutiny of the Trump administration.

item.title: US First Lady to Host Ukrainian, Russian Officials at White House
item.description: US First Lady will host Ukrainian and Russian officials at the White House on Thursday ahead of trilateral peace talks in Abu Dhabi. The meeting follows Melania Trump’s role in securing a localized ceasefire in occupied Oleshky to evacuate civilians.
item.author: AFP
item.dc:creator: AFP

item.title: Ukraine Police Release Bodycam Footage of Final Moments Before Strike Killed 42
item.description: Ukraine’s National Police released bodycam footage showing the final moments before a Russian double-tap strike on a humanitarian aid distribution site in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. Forty-two people have been killed, and another 33 may remain trapped under the rubble.
